entity_types.Resource: Surface, transport attachment or right identity
entity_types.Frame: Generation, geometry, color and allocation result
entity_types.Event: Timestamped request, render, completion, cancellation or release
entity_types.Evidence: Scoped source document or sealed experiment
entity_types.Artifact: Source, asset, test or implementation deliverable

ASSERTS.description: The scoped source report explicitly states the Claim proposition. Documentary attribution only; does not imply truth, runtime observation or semantic support.

competency_questions: Which native observation supports a required Canvas behavior on this exact build?
Which source/control failures invalidate a claim?
Which missing prerequisite blocks the highest-value research?
Which resource identity survives which session or frame generation?
Which completion and release events were correlated in one owned session?
Which bytes include row padding and unused allocation tail?
Which repeated probes are already covered in the same scope/version?
Which specs can a fresh implementer receive without research exposure?
Which milestone checks still lack independent native or platform evidence?
